title: 菊花賞の後に・着陸予定、イマダナシ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mayano Top Gun has won the Kikuka Sho with ease. A reporter named Otonashi comes to interview her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During the interview, Mayano Top Gun talks about Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Otonashi follows up by asking if she is planning on racing in the Arima Kinen, the next race Narita Brian will compete in.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mayano Top Gun replies that she will race there if it means competing directly against Narita Brian.
